name: Ha Long food guide
summary: Ha Long eats squid cake on the boats and at Tết, then seafood cooked on the spot along the Bãi Cháy night streets. Quan Lạn sea worm, Cô Tô dried squid, and Quảng Yên ruốc belong to other shores.
body: Eat Hạ Long for chả mực. The tourism pages put the squid cake on the cruise boats, at provincial banquets, and on the Tết table as a dish and a gift. Xôi chả mực and bún cù kỳ Hạ Long are named beside it. Hải sản is the night plate at Bãi Cháy and along the Hạ Long shore, cooked on the spot.

No breakfast dish was named. No sweet and no daily drink were named. The 2024 festival served beer with the squid cake. That was the festival. Sá sùng is Quan Lạn and Vân Đồn. Mực một nắng is Cô Tô. Ruốc is Quảng Yên. Canh cá ngần nấu chua was honored as a Quảng Ninh dish in 2023 and is not placed on a Hạ Long street. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Four plates are named for Hạ Long. The photograph is the fried squid cakes.

sections.heading: Specialties
highlights: Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long
paragraphs: The named plates are chả mực Hạ Long, xôi chả mực, bún cù kỳ Hạ Long, and hải sản cooked on the spot at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long. The plate with a photograph is the squid cake.

Chả mực Hạ Long is the squid cake the tourism pages call one of 50 specialties recognized by Trung tâm Sách kỷ lục Việt Nam. It is served on the cruise boats and at provincial banquets. The Tết article calls it a dish of Quảng Ninh cooking and a gift. Eat it hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm. A recipe, a species beyond mực, and a texture word were not on those pages. A breakfast clock was not printed.

Xôi chả mực is named in the same breath as the squid cake. The page does not say how the rice is cooked. The cake line says you eat chả mực with xôi trắng. This name is the rice and the cake together. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
Bún cù kỳ Hạ Long is named on the provincial food list beside chả mực. The page does not describe the bowl. How to eat it, and when, were not printed. Check on arrival.

Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long is seafood cooked on the spot. A winter article says Quảng Ninh seafood is often xào, luộc, or hấp, and also dried. No species list for the Hạ Long bowl was printed. The night article puts this plate on the Bãi Cháy evening streets. A lunch hour was not printed.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The casual doors are streets and counters, not a ranked shop list. Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Friday and Saturday. Công luận also says holidays and Tết. Dân trí does not. Both stay. The 2023 reports say phường Bạch Đằng. The 2025 resolution puts Bạch Đằng in phường Hồng Gai. On the Bãi Cháy side, the night article groups phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza after dark, and prints no hour.
The fast-food counter is inside Sun World, not on those streets. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: Themed eating on the opened pages is the Dragon Park buffet, the set meals tied to the cable car and the fireworks, the 2024 beer-and-squid-cake festival, and the squid cake on the cruise boats. No boat brand is a pick. A buffet price, apart from the cable-car combos below, was not printed.

The combos are tickets, not a stall price. Queen cable car plus the food set is 450,000 đồng for an adult and 350,000 for a child. Queen cable car plus the VUI-Fest set is 650,000 and 550,000. Queen cable car plus the Bavaria set is 750,000 and 650,000. The basic cable table defines a child as 1 m–1.4 m. These combo lines say trẻ em and do not repeat the height.
